value.value: Estimate required shell material from core concentration, core size and successive shell volume increments, assuming complete precursor conversion and one monolayer equal to half the wurtzite c parameter. These assumptions do not constitute measured lattice constants or atomic coordinates.

value.value: The authors speculate that the secondary amine functions as a base but is disfavored as a thick-shell bound ligand by steric crowding. Surface flattening favors oleate. Figure S5 is a conceptual packing drawing; its branched descriptor refers to the secondary-amine architecture, not an identified carbon-chain isomer.

measurements.technique: Source text with explicit reported/model/context scope

value.value: Cd-binding ligands are proposed to stabilize Cd-terminated wurtzite surfaces; sulfur addition is proposed to reconstruct surfaces and reduce dipole strength. The source says cycling behavior does not depend on whether Cd or S begins the shell sequence. The generic Scheme 1 starts with anion, whereas the preferred protocol first prepassivates cores with Cd.
